title: The Right Path
description: This mod gives you speed II when running on paths!
body:
Ever felt like roads in Minecraft should actually make traveling faster?

The Right Path rewards players for staying on the road. When you sprint on dirt paths, you gain a Speed II boost, making long journeys smoother and faster.

Build roads, connect your villages, and finally take the right path.

Features

🛣️ Speed II while sprinting on dirt paths

⚡ Makes roads actually useful for travel

🌍 Perfect for survival worlds and exploration

🪶 Lightweight and simple — no unnecessary extras

Why?

Paths are meant to guide travelers, but in vanilla Minecraft they don’t really help you move faster.
This mod gives roads a purpose by making them the fastest way to move across your world.

Minecraft Version

Minecraft: 1.20.1

Forge: 47.4.10
